baseline_gate: all A/B/C/F3 complete rankings exact; rerender all old arm/ratio/view cases; per-view and aggregate max abs<=1e-6; then generate F1/F2
F1: frozen final leaves, first three reps identical to C; complete conditional marginal sequence; head-only predecessor-preserving merge

progressive_semantics.coarse_capacity: up to 3 NEW globally unselected representatives; if fewer remain, finish immediately
progressive_semantics.objective_population: all original node members, including already emitted rows (self coverage makes their residual zero)
progressive_semantics.inherited_coverage: max kappa over all emitted ancestors on path, including ancestors outside the child bounds; no sibling/cross-root coverage
progressive_semantics.internal_unlock: after min(3,remaining) NEW reps emitted, activate every nonempty child with all ancestor coverage; node with no remaining rows is exhausted and its descendants still traversed as necessary
progressive_semantics.leaf_F2: fixed independent residual after inherited+leaf coarse cover; never update residual coverage
progressive_semantics.leaf_F3: continue conditional marginal tail and update coverage

heap_tie: descending gain/priority; lexicographic (root gx,gy,gz,octree path) stable node key; source row ascending; one exposed item per active node/leaf
local_tie: exact equal maximum marginal gain, then source row ascending; no quantization
gain_checks: nonnegative >=-1e-12 and local diminishing returns tolerance 1e-10*max(1,node_raw_mass); no gain reordering repair
geometry_diagnostic: unchanged fixed-h8 cell metric, max offdiagonal selected kappa per row, singleton0; unordered thresholds .8/.9/.95
evaluation: same 54 fixed non-Bank archived views; same 18 Bank frozen contribution; no export/update
F1_gate: 10% and15% mean redundancy at least10% below C and >.9 pairs nonincreasing, mean high-ratio delta PSNR>=-.03
F2_gate: 1% delta PSNR>=+.05 and each5/10/15% delta PSNR>=-.03
F3_gate: four-ratio mean delta PSNR>=0; 1% delta PSNR>0; both10/15% mean redundancy<C
F3_strong: F3_gate plus mean PSNR>=B-.02, mean-of-four redundancy<=1.10*B mean and total >.9 pair counts<=1.10*B (integer ceiling, minimum allowance1 for zero)
Q5_Fixed_comparison: EXCEEDS if mean deltaPSNR>=+.02; MATCHES if mean>=-.02; otherwise BELOW; include each metric separately
high_budget_metrics: report SSIM/photo direction; no additional overall gate or tuning from these metrics; not optimize
